messages:
Evan: Quick check on compare table—noticed focus ring gets hidden by the perf badges on hover/focus.

Sofia: I saw that too. On compact rows the badge sits on top of the left edge.

Noah: Can we reorder DOM so title receives focus first and badge later? Keep visual layout the same with CSS order.

Sofia: Also badge copy inconsistency: some badges are qualitative only. Suggest numeric primary + qualifier: 'p95 20ms · Fast'.

Evan: Agree. Accessibility: add aria-label 'p95 latency 20 milliseconds, fast' and ensure contrast >= AA.

Noah: I'll prototype moving badge node after title, add aria-label, and two color token options (solid high-contrast, border variant).

Evan: Microcopy for pin: use 'Pin version (session)' with tooltip that says 'Temporary: pinned for this compare session'.

Sofia: Acceptance: focus ring visible, badges numeric+qualifier, badges have aria-labels, pin tooltip clarifies session scope.

design-bot: Reminder: attach before/after screenshots to PR and include keyboard-only test steps. :robot_face:

Noah: Will open PR tonight with screenshots.
